name: scan-now
description: Run passive website-security scans and inspect suspicious links with Scan.now.

interface.longDescription: Run passive, read-only website security checks and inspect suspicious links for phishing signals. Scan.now checks public pages, TLS, security headers, DNS and email posture, JavaScript libraries, redirects, lookalike domains, and other observable signals without sending exploit payloads.
defaultPrompt: Scan my website for security problems.
Check this suspicious link for phishing.
Review my site's TLS and security headers.
